rules.EXPERIMENTAL: May be routed in USE/SKIP decisions but flagged as unproven; not eligible for L3+ automatic invocation.
rules.VALIDATED: Passed routing + safety + drift evals at least once; eligible per normal risk-tier rules.
rules.DEPRECATED: SKIP by default; kept for reference and migration history only.
rules.QUARANTINED: BLOCK always, regardless of eligibility filter result — used after a safety incident.
